before.label: today: manual
before.total: ≈ 23 min of staff time per dispute (blended)

steps.task: Pull new disputes from the PSP portals and log them in the tracking sheet
Read the notice and reason code; work out what evidence that code needs
Find the order in the OMS and the payment record with AVS, CVV and 3-D Secure results
Pull carrier tracking and proof of delivery
Search the helpdesk for customer emails and chats; check refund history
Decide whether to accept or fight
Write the rebuttal, build the evidence pack and upload it before the deadline
Track outcomes and reconcile wins and losses with finance

after.label: agent workflow
after.total: ≈ 1.9 min of human time per dispute (blended)

steps.task: Receive disputes by PSP webhook, map reason codes, compute the internal deadline
Label the claim type from the notice and cardholder text; route by deadline
Fetch order, payment checks, tracking, helpdesk threads, refunds and prior orders
Auto-accept below the cost-to-fight floor or with no evidence; settle clear cases
Pull the facts that matter from customer threads and order notes, with citations
Decide accept or fight on the cases the rules cannot settle, with a confidence score
Write the rebuttal against the reason code and pick the exhibits
Approve fights of $250 or more and every low-confidence decision
Assemble and check the pack, submit through the PSP API, record the outcome
